run_contract.grading: Grade outcomes from the response and trace. Do not require exact wording or headings. Supply only this skill; the case tests that the skill works without its sibling writing skills.

cases.prompt:
Rewrite this in plain language for customer admins.

In accordance with the data processing addendum, and subject to the exceptions enumerated herein, it should be
noted that the deletion of tenant data subsequent to the termination of a subscription agreement will be effected
by the service provider within a period not exceeding 30 calendar days from the effective date of termination,
with the exception of encrypted backup copies, which, owing to technical constraints inherent in the backup
architecture, may persist for a period of up to 90 days, during which time they are not accessible for the purpose
of restoration by the tenant; this applies solely to tenants hosted in the EU region, as tenants in other regions
are governed by the retention schedule set out in Annex C, and administrators wishing to obtain a deletion
certificate are required to submit a request through the admin console no later than 60 days after termination.
cases.behavior: Change register for a plain-language request while keeping every number, condition, and scope limit.
outcomes: Keeps 30 calendar days, backups up to 90 days and not restorable, the EU-only scope, Annex C for other regions, and the certificate request in the admin console within 60 days of termination.
Lets the admin say after one reading what happens to their data and what they must do.
Replaces bureaucratic wording such as effected, subsequent, and herein with familiar words, and addresses the reader directly.
Flags the ambiguous scope of the EU-only sentence for the author instead of resolving it silently.
